text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Kawakami 
Princess...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess was gazing intently at a 
claw crane machine filled with plushies 
inspired by Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. As if I have the slightest 
interest in that sort of thing.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess, getting obsessed with a 
crane game simply isn't graceful, you 
know?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
In the first place, trying to grab a 
plushie with such a weak arm is 
completely, totally, utterly out of the 
question!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... But never mind. With a claw like 
that, it's simply impossible—
choice_data_list:
Even a little strength is all about how 
you use it!

Even a little strength is all about how 
you use it.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Gasp?! Come to think of it, they said 
it in episode 26 of PreFy too! 'Even a 
tiny crab has its pincers'!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Even small strength, when harnessed 
properly, can capture a whale"...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... Please, show me the power of 
the tiny crab!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
